author: Forbes
description:
The 2026 Rivian R2 arrives as a high-stakes transition meant to take the brand from niche luxury to a global mass-market powerhouse. Designed to compete directly in the mid-size SUV category—the largest automotive segment in the world—the R2 is engineered with "global intent" to scale Rivian’s adventurous identity into Europe and China. With a targeted starting price of approximately $58,000, this vehicle represents a $20,000 price drop from the flagship R1, aiming to place high-end EV design in the hands of a much broader audience.

Success for the R2 hinges on a radical leap in manufacturing efficiency. By co-developing the vehicle and its production line simultaneously, Rivian has eliminated 2.3 miles of wiring and replaced thousands of fasteners with high-pressure die castings, reducing the vehicle’s mass by 2,000 lbs compared to the R1. Milan Harris, Founder and CEO of apparel company Milano Di Rouge, joins Forbes senior writer Jabari Young on The Enterprise Zone at Nasdaq MarketSite. During the discussion, Harris updates the fashion line she started in 2012, which eclipsed $100 million in sales by 2020. Additionally, she reflects on growing up in Philadelphia, revamping her leadership style, and expanding her real estate portfolio.
